config.precision: float32 inputs and parameters, CUDA bfloat16 autocast, no GradScaler; v1 float16 aborted on gradient overflow before any completed fit
config.checkpoint: fixed epoch 10; no target selection or early stopping
config.source_split: canonical train_01 per vehicle; final recording suffix for source validation
config.target: all unique unambiguous captures assigned to held-out vehicle; no target training/calibration
config.duplicates: merge identical binary cache hashes; quarantine all hashes with inconsistent vehicle assignments
config.relative_features: structural indices [0,9,...,29]; remove eight absolute payload bytes
config.conditional_adversary: two MLP heads (benign/attack) predict three source vehicle identities; GRL ramps to 0.1
config.balanced_sampling: 21 samples with replacement from every source vehicle x binary label cell per batch; same indices across methods
config.probe: four balanced vehicles x binary label; canonical source train/validation recording groups; LR and MLP plus constant/permuted controls; diagnostic only after checkpoints frozen
config.probe_mlp: StandardScaler + MLP(64,32), Adam, alpha=0.01, max_iter=200, random_state=42, no target tuning
config.primary: held-out-vehicle recall at source-calibrated threshold, jointly interpreted with target FAR
limitations: Previously inspected vehicles: exploratory, not new independent confirmation
Recording-round grouping does not establish independent drives
Content/file-order only; no physical chronology claim
Binary class alignment does not equate attack-family distributions
Probe train may overlap encoder source training captures; probe test holds out recording rounds
Probe near chance does not prove statistical independence
No original A/B/C/D claim for new multi-source folds; attack family familiarity is recomputed from source training
